alternatives.description: Other models they are cross-shopping, if any.

must_haves.description: Genuinely non-negotiable requirements. A hard filter: never traded away in negotiation.

nice_to_haves.description: Wanted but tradeable. These are the only features that may be conceded for savings.

timeline.description: As the buyer put it: 'this week', 'within a month', 'just looking'.

trade_in_written_offer_usd.description: An independent written offer, e.g. CarMax or Carvana. This is the floor for the trade.

market_reference_usd.description: What the buyer says comparable cars are LISTED at. A market observation, not their budget.

buyer_stated_maximum_usd.description: PRIVATE. Only if volunteered. NEVER passed to a dealer-facing agent, never used as a target, never spoken aloud. Present so downstream code can guard it explicitly rather than have it leak through a general notes field.

confirmed_by_user.description: Did the buyer confirm a read-back summary on the call? An unconfirmed spec must not be used for calls.

notes.description: Material context. MUST NOT contain the buyer's maximum or any figure they want kept private.
